description: Routine updates arrive weekly and grouped by ecosystem, so a batch is triaged as one review rather than ten.
fetchChangeLogs is off because the content job checks the pull-request body for house style, which upstream release notes do not follow.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh Cargo.lock weekly, which is how a transitive advisory fix reaches the graph without a manifest bump.

packageRules.description: wit-parser is pinned to the version wasmtime embeds and moves with it by hand. A bump on its own is silent: the WIT cross-check passes against the wrong parser.
CI pins every action by digest; Renovate keeps the digest and its version comment in step.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A security fix leaves the weekly batch and its group, so it is not lost behind a routine bump.
